summary: Solo skier buried and killed in an avalanche on the northeast end of the Anthracite Range; found by two other skiers via transceiver.
location: Anthracite Range (Friendly Finish area), west of Crested Butte
responding_agency: Crested Butte Search and Rescue; Gunnison County (volunteers)
notes: Solo skier buried on Friday; two other skiers located him with a transceiver and pulled him out but he did not survive; CAIC reported weakest snowpack since 2012. CBN account: 15 CBSAR members responded Friday afternoon; victim located via transceiver and dug out by bystanders before the CBSAR field team arrived. Merged CAIC classic 2020-21 season table row.
